title: Owner drags a work order row to another technician group in Tech View
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport at least 1280 px wide
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API (display List, no layout keys), then technicians A and B are pinned in that saved preference, so their groups follow Unassigned
For a unique customer: work order W1 with lead A and work order W2 with lead B (so B's group has a row to drop on), each with one line. No shifts for A

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Tech View, and search for the unique customer
custom_steps_separated.expected: W1 is in A's group and W2 in B's group

custom_steps_separated.content: Drag W1's row onto W2's row and release
custom_steps_separated.expected: A drop indicator shows; then "Lead technician updated" and W1 is in B's group, with both group counts updated

W1 is still in B's group

Dragging a Tech View row to another technician's group changes the lead, and the change persists
